deviations: Interrogation batched into grouped principal spawns (4 dimension batches + 1 deck-arbitration spawn) rather than one-question-per-turn per spawn. Protocol permits per-question-BATCH spawns; batching was used to bound spawn count. Adaptivity preserved across batches (each spawn received the full dialogue-so-far), but within a batch multiple questions were posed together, a minor departure from analysis-iterative's strict one-question-per-turn ideal.

Cold intent review sized down from the default first-ratification PAIR to a SOLO reviewer. This is within the command's lead-sizing latitude; the departure-trail rationale is recorded in the synthesis Review section (greenfield, small element count, zero floor waivers -> little coverage-lens blind surface; solo cold read retained for the two load-bearing intents). No cross-examination phase (solo).

Single-agent simulation (per RUN-PROTOCOL): the run-lead played every seat, including the cold reviewer whose Phase 0 blind map is, in a real run, built by a separately-spawned agent with no session exposure. Here the blind map was performed best-effort from topic-only reasoning by the same agent that authored the synthesis; this is the inherent independence limitation the protocol acknowledges for single-agent simulation, mitigated by grading grader outputs strictly from artifact text.
